annual_report.business: Suyog Telematics Limited is a passive telecom infrastructure provider engaged in building, operating and maintaining telecom towers, poles and Optical Fiber Cable networks, providing ready-to-use infrastructure to telecommunications service providers under long-term Master Service Agreements.

key_risks: Provisional revenue recognition pending final reconciliation with telecom operators

MSME dues identification and interest computation subject to ongoing reconciliations

Vodafone final quarterly guidance awaited; tentative numbers received, firm confirmation expected in few days
Expect BSNL pending 300 sites billing to start in Q3-Q4 FY27; target to complete all pending BSNL sites this financial year
Revenue per tower to remain ~INR 30,000-31,000/month; marginal increase only
